context:
User authorized ongoing collaboration and building Continuum, an original MIT native AI work/evidence engine. Latest user: "I'm not sure this GitHub mobile app, the second factor is blocking. I'm not receiving requests for anything. Let's defer. Let's defer the GitHub operation for now. Continue with everything and everything else that you can, and I'll be at my desktop soon enough to resolve this issue." We stopped authentication/publication; all useful local work continues.

Previous implemented slice (verified locally with 11 tests): exact Blob/Snapshot/EvidenceRecord domain-separated SHA256 envelopes, SQLite WAL acceptance expected-root+generation, operation-id request binding and durable original receipts after process death. Acceptor names are unauthenticated namespaces; no remote runner/model calls. Core is native, Git an interoperability boundary. Prior two actual Claude exchanges and original user transcription are preserved.

Current phase-1 proposal from implementer (not yet tested): WorkState {schema:'continuum.work_state.v1',id,source_snapshot,objective:{id,statement,done_when,constraints[]},attempts:[{id,operation_id,source_snapshot,summary,dispatch_state:never_dispatched|may_have_been_sent|receipt_recorded,request:BlobID,receipt:BlobID|null,outcome_note}],decisions:[{id,state:active|historical,statement,basis_attempt_ids[],reopen_when}],uncertainties:[{id,question,why_it_matters}],handoff:{id,from_worker,to_worker,scope,required_decision_ids[]}}. One objective/offered handoff per state; IDs globally unique locally, all referenced objects checked, each attempt retains its historical snapshot. All attempts/uncertainties/active decisions/required decisions mandatory. Only unrequired historical decisions omitted whole, IDs/reasons listed. Derived guidance per attempt: issue_first_request/reconcile_existing_operation/inspect_recorded_receipt; receipt is not success. PrepareRequest gives stored work-state BlobID and byte budget; deterministic ContextPack retains source/selected exact rendering and manifest Blob IDs, selector revision, byte method, included IDs/omissions/limits. Fail if mandatory information cannot fit. Recipient receipt explicitly names recipient and pack, acknowledges all required actions and uncertainties. Consistency validation, no authentication/truth/dispatch proof. Recursive duplicate-key rejection and byte/record/text bounds. No source codec or database-schema change.

Research exposure: direct review of 88 Base12 source/doc files plus currently extending coherent subtree, full tree inventoried not full semantic review. Prime Radiant live repo unavailable; retained kit's substantive docs/current source read; historical records now extending. A Prime record narrowed to 41 checks while earlier 42-check raw JSON had been overwritten: need distinguish exact original custody from surviving authored observations and later interpretations. Representation test: identical source in A/B but external operation may have been sent in A vs never dispatched in B => different appropriate next action. No claim this synthetic pair proves model performance.
request: Co-design review of this next slice, not a general architecture essay: what are the 3 most consequential concrete corrections, if any, before we rely on a prepared context for a fresh session? Prioritize actually possible false-continuation or misleading receipt states over hypothetical hardening. How should we make this context experiment discriminating without smuggling the expected answer into the evaluator prompt? Keep under 700 words. Distinguish necessary changes now from later work.
